stats.source: GOB 184 authors +15 Movement, Sneak Movement and Invisibility Movement, 25 IS on activation and each 5 s interval, and 5 s reuse. SpeedingInit/Term set and clear 0x0400.
stats.runtime: AbilityBuffs emits and removes all four records, projects +0.15 to the owner and observers, preserves the active stealth stance, and handles the spent and shortfall branches independently of the stance.
stats.test: PR723 measures matched standalone Sprint against the off baseline in Normal, Sneak and Belt (first-stop ratios 1.142, 1.145 and 1.150). Stock also confirms 25 IS every 5 s, all modifier add/remove records, preserved stances and 5 s reuse. consumer.source: The loaded 215 record is Locate Data Node Skill 703 at the trained rank. LocateDataNode_DirectObject takes range and type from the indirect item, specifies 10 s for the handheld, and passes tool and range to the search. It assigns the skill ID to an unused local.
consumer.runtime: The passive reports the trained rank. DataMining uses the selected tool's range and type, and AbilityHandler admits the active tool's stop before cast/reuse/IS checks. The locator lifecycle bootstrap verifies expiry, removal and quiet reload, including marker cleanup on unload.
consumer.test: PR679 verifies +4→+5 at the trainer and the same range and expiry at both ranks. PR724 verifies goggles and handheld by slot, 5 IS per start, marker FX and handheld expiry, quiet reload of +5, and immediate free stop at zero. Marker removal on unload was verified headlessly. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/679#issuecomment-7066256562 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/724#issuecomment-7073024397
